get.summary: Reports whether the API and its database are reachable.
Current and expected balance of an account, with its starting balance and corrections.
Loan payments of a month (yyyy-MM), with totals.
Cards for the Settings list: Default hides archived cards and expired cards without ongoing transactions.

post.summary: Adds a card. With ?replaces={id}, the new card is linked as the replacement of that card.

get.summary: Cards shown on the Dashboard, and whether any card exists at all.

put.summary: Edits a card. A null cardNumber or iban keeps the stored value; an empty string removes it.

get.summary: Reveals one full number (CardNumber or Iban) when the user asks for it.

post.summary: Marks the card as expired from today. Cannot be undone.
Archives the card instead of deleting it. Cannot be undone.

get.summary: Inputs of a month (yyyy-MM): stored inputs and calculated occurrences of recurring inputs, with totals.

post.summary: Adds an input. With a recurrence, adds a recurring input whose first occurrence has these dates.

put.summary: Edits a stored input. The recurrence field is ignored.

post.summary: Ticks Received: sets the received date to today.

delete.summary: Unticks Received: clears the received date.

put.summary: Changes the template; occurrences not yet received from today on follow it.

post.summary: Stops it: no occurrences after today.

put.summary: Changes one occurrence (by its scheduled expected date) without changing the others.

get.summary: Saved payers, optionally only those whose name contains the search text.

delete.summary: Removes the payer from the list; inputs keep its name.
Deletes an unused category; a used one returns 409 and can only be hidden.

put.summary: Changes date, balance and note; the kind stays.

get.summary: Received and expected inputs, and paid and expected loan payments, per day or month between two dates.
Monthly cash flow report of a month (yyyy-MM).
Active loans (active and paid off), or closed loans.

post.summary: Adds a loan. Give the number of payments or the end month (or both, when they agree).

get.summary: Active loans with their next payment, and the totals of the monthly payments and the remaining amount.
A loan with its payment changes and all its payments.

put.summary: Edits a loan. Paid payments stay as they are.

delete.summary: Deletes a loan without paid payments; a loan with paid payments returns 409 and can only be closed.

post.summary: Closes the loan today: it keeps its paid payments and has no payments after today.
Changes the monthly payment or the payment day from a month on.

put.summary: Edits a payment change while none of the payments it covers is paid.

delete.summary: Removes a payment change while none of the payments it covers is paid.

put.summary: Changes the amount and due date of one payment without changing the loan.

post.summary: Ticks Paid. The paid date defaults to today and the account to the loan's account.

put.summary: Renames the category and sets whether its loans may have a residual value.

delete.summary: Deletes an unused category; a used one returns 409 and can only be hidden.
Deletes an unused subcategory; a used one returns 409 and can only be hidden.
